agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Provider, scope and failure classifiers must inspect executable structure and explicit terminal fields rather than reject audit literals, package names or descriptive plan prose.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Early deterministic checks treated the installed @deepseek-ai/dsh-scope package name as provider activity and derived boundary or root-failure conclusions from vocabulary tokens rather than execution structure.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Focused deterministic ledgers failed while direct inspection showed only package identity or audit prose and no provider path, forcing structural comparison against the accepted runner.

correction.action: Replace vocabulary-only predicates with structural source checks and bind boundary classification to explicit terminal fields and focused regressions.
correction.prevention_control: Deterministic boundary guards distinguish executable imports and launches from package identifiers and audit strings; exact vocabulary is generated or parsed where possible.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records vocabulary-only false boundary classifications and their structural deterministic replacement.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every review command must name exact inspected implementation symbols, apply closed nested schemas and distinguish the literal native launch statement from annotations before external dispatch.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Successive draft manifests referenced a nonexistent checkpoint loader, admitted over-broad nested evidence shapes and matched the subprocess.Popen type annotation rather than the process launch assignment.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The local evidence gate and shell-free command validator rejected each mismatch before the final independent semantic decision was admitted.

correction.action: Inspect the exact callable and launch assignment, close every nested schema and rerun the deterministic manifest before one fresh semantic veto.
correction.prevention_control: Shell-free deterministic validation owns symbols, argv, schemas and counts; the model receives only the bounded semantic review package.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records review-manifest symbol and schema recall failures and the deterministic-facts plus semantic-veto split.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A nonzero staged-diff check must prevent the subsequent explicit-path commit rather than rely on PowerShell statement sequencing.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: A semicolon-separated command block continued to commit after git diff --cached --check reported trailing whitespace, requiring a corrective descendant commit.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The staged-diff output named the whitespace defect and later exact-history inspection showed that the commit command had still executed.

correction.action: Correct the whitespace in a descendant and separate staged validation from commit execution so the observed zero exit is a prerequisite.
correction.prevention_control: Explicit-path staging, staged-diff checking and commit execution are separate commands with independent exit observation.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the non-short-circuiting staged check and the separate-command commit control.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The package materialiser must exclusively create the installation root before proof files are created, and every prelaunch failure must publish sanitized terminal evidence.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Attempt 001 created installation/proof before the accepted offline installer claimed installation, raising FileExistsError before checkpoint consumption or native launch; the first controller shape did not preserve a terminal for that prelaunch class.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The launch command failed before any subprocess, and filesystem/process inspection confirmed zero native process, zero checkpoint consumption and a disposable partial root.

correction.action: Preserve attempt 001, move materialisation before proof creation and make sanitized prelaunch terminal publication part of the controller contract.
correction.prevention_control: One component owns each disposable path creation boundary, and process/count evidence distinguishes prelaunch failure from a native attempt.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves attempt 001's installation-root ownership collision and the terminal-preserving ordering repair.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Provider-free package materialisation must be bounded, own and terminate every child, publish terminal evidence on cleanup failure and leave no disposable root before a native process begins.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Attempt 002's offline npm materialiser exceeded 300 seconds, left one exact npm child holding the disposable root and then raised PermissionError during cleanup before terminal publication; no native process started.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Checkpoint state, process inspection and the immutable failure record identified the exact package PID, zero native processes, zero model activity and the retained temporary root.

correction.action: Identity-verify and terminate the child, remove the verified disposable root and replace npm with a zero-process copy of the exact accepted content- and lock-bound package tree.
correction.prevention_control: Materialisation validates accepted source digests and critical packages before and after copy; cleanup is bounded and always maps to a sanitized terminal state.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves attempt 002's npm child and cleanup escape and the zero-process bound-tree replacement.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A destructive cleanup must resolve and validate the exact absolute disposable target, retain one shell or language end to end and never combine computed enumeration with recursive deletion.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first recovery command combined process and path operations in a form rejected by the Windows safety layer, and a later recursive Remove-Item call was also blocked; neither deletion ran.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The command layer rejected both operations before filesystem mutation while separate read-only checks proved the exact PID and target containment.

correction.action: Separate identity and containment checks, then remove only the already verified temporary root through one explicit language-local operation and verify absence.
correction.prevention_control: Cleanup implementations own target resolution, containment, deletion and absence verification in one bounded language path; ad hoc recursive shell cleanup is excluded.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected cross-shell deletion procedure and the bounded language-local cleanup control.
